words.definition: n. 股份；赌注；利害关系；vt. 拿…冒险

examples.en: The firm holds a forty percent stake in the joint venture.
examples.zh: 该公司在合资企业中持有百分之四十的股份。

examples.en: Thousands of jobs are at stake in the merger.
examples.zh: 这场并购中数千个岗位面临风险。

words.usage: at stake 处于危险中（考研高频）；have a stake in… 与…利害相关；a controlling stake 控股权。派生：stakeholder 利益相关者。
collocations: at stake 处于危险中
a controlling stake 控股权
have a stake in… 与…利害攸关
words.mnemonic: 谐音「死跌」→ 股价跌光赌注全押上 → 赌注

words.definition: adj. 永恒的；永久的

examples.en: Ancient kings searched in vain for the secret of eternal life.
examples.zh: 古代君王追求永生的秘密，终归徒劳。

examples.en: The city seems to suffer from eternal traffic congestion.
examples.zh: 这座城市似乎永远饱受交通拥堵之苦。

words.usage: eternal life 永生；eternal truths 永恒真理；口语可指「没完没了的」。派生：eternity n. 永恒（for eternity）；eternally adv. 永远地。
collocations: eternal life 永生
eternal truth 永恒真理
eternal gratitude 永远的感激
words.mnemonic: e+tern（季节轮转）→ 四季不停 → 永恒

words.definition: vt./vi. 疏散，撤离；排空

examples.en: Thousands of residents were evacuated before the typhoon landed.
examples.zh: 台风登陆前数千居民被疏散。

examples.en: The staff were trained to evacuate the building in three minutes.
examples.zh: 员工受过三分钟内撤离大楼的培训。

words.usage: evacuate sb from… to… 把…疏散到…；evacuate the building 撤出大楼。派生：evacuation n. 疏散；evacuee n. 被疏散者。
collocations: evacuate the building 撤出大楼
evacuate residents 疏散居民
evacuate the area 撤离该地区
words.mnemonic: e（出）+vacu（空）→ 撤空 → 疏散

words.definition: aux. 应当，应该；大概会（表推测）

examples.en: You ought to check the contract carefully before signing it.
examples.zh: 签字之前你应当仔细核对合同。

examples.en: These outdated regulations ought to have been revised years ago.
examples.zh: 这些过时的规定早在多年前就该修订了。

words.usage: 情态动词，后接 to do，无人称时态变化；否定 ought not to；ought to have done 表本应做而未做，含责备义；疑问句把 ought 提前。
collocations: ought to do sth 应该做某事
ought to be 应当是
ought not to 不应该
words.mnemonic: ought 谐音「奥特」→ 奥特曼 ought to 守护地球 → 应当

words.definition: vt. 抵制，拒绝购买；拒绝参加 n. 抵制

examples.en: Consumers boycotted the brand after the safety scandal was exposed.
examples.zh: 安全丑闻曝光后，消费者纷纷抵制该品牌。

examples.en: Several nations threatened a boycott of the tournament over human rights concerns.
examples.zh: 几个国家以人权问题为由威胁抵制那场赛事。

words.usage: 及物动词直接跟宾语，多用于新闻语境；名词常搭 impose/lift a boycott 发起或解除抵制；可数名词，无常用派生词。
collocations: boycott products 抵制产品
impose a boycott on 对…实行抵制
lift a boycott 取消抵制
words.mnemonic: 源于英国经纪人 Boycott 遭佃农联合抵制 → 抵制

words.definition: v. 反驳，回嘴 n. 反驳，回嘴的话

examples.en: She retorted angrily that the criticism was entirely unfair.
examples.zh: 她气愤地反驳说那种批评完全不公平。

examples.en: His witty retort drew laughter from the whole audience.
examples.zh: 他机智的反驳引得全场大笑。

words.usage: 及物动词可接 that 从句，也可作不及物；名词搭配 a sharp retort 尖锐的反驳；比 answer 更强调带情绪的回击，书面口语皆可。
collocations: retort angrily 愤怒地反驳
a sharp retort 尖锐的反驳
retort that... 反驳说…
words.mnemonic: re(回)+tort(扭) → 把话扭回去 → 反驳

words.definition: n. 郊区，市郊；边缘地带

examples.en: The factory was relocated to the outskirts of the city to cut costs.
examples.zh: 工厂为削减成本迁到了市郊。

examples.en: They bought a quiet house on the northern outskirts of the town.
examples.zh: 他们在小镇北郊买了一栋安静的房子。

words.usage: 恒用复数，谓语动词用复数；固定介词搭配 on the outskirts of 在某地郊区；指城市建成区外缘，与 suburb 相比更强调边缘属性。
collocations: on the outskirts of 在…郊区
the city outskirts 城市边缘
live on the outskirts 住在市郊
words.mnemonic: out(外)+skirts(裙边) → 城市裙摆之外 → 郊区

words.definition: adj. （接触）传染的；（情绪）有感染力的

examples.en: Measles is a highly contagious disease that spreads through the air.
examples.zh: 麻疹是一种通过空气传播的高传染性疾病。

examples.en: Her enthusiasm for the project proved contagious.
examples.zh: 她对项目的热情被证明很有感染力。

words.usage: 本义指接触性传染，与 infectious 的辨析常考；引申指情绪感染：contagious laughter；常搭 be highly contagious；派生 contagion n. 传染。

confusables.note: 视条件而定的，本表第34词

collocations: a contagious disease 传染病
contagious laughter 有感染力的笑声
highly contagious 传染性极强的
words.mnemonic: con+tag(接触)+ious → 一碰就染上 → 传染的

words.definition: vt. 使厌恶，使反感 n. 厌恶，憎恶

examples.en: The smell from the kitchen disgusted everyone in the office.
examples.zh: 厨房飘来的气味让办公室里的每个人都感到恶心。

examples.en: She resigned in disgust at the company's dishonest practices.
examples.zh: 她因反感公司的不诚信做法而辞职。

words.usage: 及物动词，物作主语：The smell disgusted me；be disgusted at/by sth 对…感到厌恶；in disgust 厌恶地；派生 disgusting 令人作呕的。
collocations: be disgusted at 对…感到厌恶
in disgust 厌恶地
disgust at sth 对…的反感
words.mnemonic: dis(无)+gust(胃口) → 倒胃口 → 厌恶

words.definition: n. 回顾，回想；追溯

examples.en: In retrospect, the committee should have consulted more independent experts.
examples.zh: 现在回想起来，委员会当时应当咨询更多独立专家。

examples.en: The crisis seemed avoidable in retrospect, though few foresaw it then.
examples.zh: 回顾起来那场危机本可避免，尽管当时很少有人预见。

words.usage: 几乎只用于短语 in retrospect 回想起来；形容词 retrospective 回顾的、追溯的，如 retrospective study；与 prospect 前景正反对照记忆。
collocations: in retrospect 回想起来
retrospective study 回顾性研究
a retrospective exhibition 回顾展
words.mnemonic: retro(向后)+spect(看) → 向后看 → 回顾

words.definition: adj. 革命的；突破性的，彻底变革的 n. 革命者

examples.en: The invention of the microchip had a revolutionary impact on daily life.
examples.zh: 微芯片的发明对日常生活产生了革命性影响。

examples.en: The young revolutionaries called for an end to the old order.
examples.zh: 年轻的革命者呼吁终结旧秩序。

words.usage: 形容词兼指政治革命的与突破性的；名词指革命者、变革者；派生 revolution n. 革命、revolutionize vt. 彻底变革，词群常在阅读同现。
collocations: revolutionary change 彻底的变革
a revolutionary idea 革命性的想法
the Revolutionary War 独立战争
words.mnemonic: revolution(革命)+ary → 革命的；革命者

words.definition: n. 折扣 vt. 打折；不全信，低估

examples.en: Students can claim a ten percent discount on train tickets.
examples.zh: 学生购火车票可享受九折优惠。

examples.en: Experts discounted the rumor as baseless speculation.
examples.zh: 专家认为该谣言毫无根据，未予采信。

words.usage: 重音区分词性：名词读 ˈdɪskaʊnt，动词读 dɪsˈkaʊnt；at a discount 打折；offer a discount 提供折扣；动词另有低估、不予采信之义。

confusables.note: v.数数，去掉 dis 即得

collocations: at a discount 打折
offer a discount 提供折扣
discount the risk 低估风险
words.mnemonic: dis(不)+count(计数) → 不按全价数 → 折扣

words.definition: v. 处理，处置；排列，布置；使倾向于

examples.en: Nuclear waste must be disposed of under strict regulations.
examples.zh: 核废料必须在严格监管下处理。

examples.en: The manager disposed the chairs in a semicircle for the discussion.
examples.zh: 经理把椅子摆成半圆形以便讨论。

words.usage: 核心短语 dispose of sth 处理掉，考研高频；at one's disposal 任凭使用；dispose sb to do 使倾向于；派生 disposable 一次性的。
collocations: dispose of waste 处理废弃物
at one's disposal 供某人使用
dispose sb to do 使倾向于做
words.mnemonic: dis(分开)+pose(放) → 分开放好 → 处置；排列

words.definition: adj. 悲惨的，可悲的；悲剧（性）的

examples.en: The whole nation mourned the tragic loss of the young scientist.
examples.zh: 全国哀悼这位年轻科学家的不幸离世。

examples.en: The novel ends on a tragic note despite its humorous beginning.
examples.zh: 尽管开头幽默，小说却以悲剧收场。

words.usage: 既修饰悲惨事件 a tragic accident，也指戏剧的悲剧性 tragic flaw；名词 tragedy，反义 comedy；副词 tragically 常置句首修饰全句。
collocations: a tragic accident 悲惨事故
tragic consequences 悲剧性后果
a tragic flaw 悲剧性缺陷
words.mnemonic: 同 tragedy（悲剧）一族 → 悲惨的；悲剧的

words.definition: v. 鞠躬，点头；屈服 n. 鞠躬；弓；蝴蝶结

examples.en: The performers bowed to the audience at the end of the play.
examples.zh: 演出结束时演员们向观众鞠躬。

examples.en: He finally bowed to pressure and withdrew the proposal.
examples.zh: 他最终屈服于压力，撤回了提案。

words.usage: 一词多音：鞠躬、屈服义读 baʊ，弓、蝴蝶结义读 bəʊ，考研常考；bow to pressure 屈服于压力；bow out 退出；take a bow 谢幕。
collocations: bow to pressure 屈服于压力
take a bow 谢幕
bow out gracefully 体面退出
words.mnemonic: 鞠躬时身体弯成一张弓（bow）→ 一词两音两义

words.definition: n. 爆发，突然发生；（疾病的）发作蔓延

examples.en: The outbreak of the epidemic forced the city into lockdown.
examples.zh: 疫情的爆发迫使该城市进入封锁状态。

examples.en: Diplomats worked day and night to prevent an outbreak of hostilities.
examples.zh: 外交官们日夜努力防止敌对行动爆发。

words.usage: 名词，由短语 break out 名词化而来，指战争、疾病、火灾等突然爆发；常见搭配 the outbreak of war；勿与 breakthrough 突破相混。
collocations: the outbreak of war 战争爆发
an outbreak of cholera 霍乱爆发
prevent an outbreak 防止爆发
words.mnemonic: break out（爆发）名词化 → 疫情战争之爆发

words.definition: n. 邮票；印章；跺脚 v. 盖章；跺脚；表明

examples.en: She stuck a stamp on the envelope and dropped it into the mailbox.
examples.zh: 她在信封上贴好邮票，投进了邮筒。

examples.en: The rescue operation stamped him as a born leader.
examples.zh: 那次救援行动表明他是一位天生的领导者。

words.usage: 名词兼指邮票、印章、跺脚；动词盖章、跺脚；短语 stamp out 扑灭、根除；stamp sb as sth 表明某人是某种人，考研曾考。
collocations: stamp out corruption 根除腐败
collect stamps 集邮
stamp on the ground 用力踩地
words.mnemonic: 盖章（stamp）先跺脚用力 → 邮票印章跺脚一体

words.definition: vt. 假扮，化妆；掩饰 n. 伪装，伪装品

examples.en: The thief disguised himself as a maintenance worker to enter the building.
examples.zh: 小偷假扮成维修工人进入大楼。

examples.en: She could not disguise her disappointment at the result.
examples.zh: 她无法掩饰对结果的失望。

words.usage: 常用 disguise oneself as 把自己扮成；disguise one's feelings 掩饰情感；名词短语 in disguise 伪装的；a blessing in disguise 因祸得福。
collocations: disguise oneself as 把自己扮成
a blessing in disguise 因祸得福
in disguise 伪装起来
words.mnemonic: dis(变)+guise(样子) → 变了样子 → 伪装

words.definition: n. 原木；日志，记录 v. 记录；伐木

examples.en: The captain logged the ship's position every four hours.
examples.zh: 船长每四小时记录一次船位。

examples.en: Users can track their reading time in the app's activity log.
examples.zh: 用户可以在应用的活动日志中追踪阅读时长。

words.usage: 名词本义原木，引申日志、记录：keep a log 记日志；log in 登录、log out 注销，网络语境高频；派生 logging n. 伐木业。
collocations: log in 登录
keep a log of 记录…的日志
sleep like a log 睡得极沉
words.mnemonic: 原木刻痕记事 → log 兼指原木与日志

words.definition: n. 差异，不一致；出入，不符之处

examples.en: Auditors found a discrepancy between the two financial reports.
examples.zh: 审计人员发现两份财务报告之间存在出入。

examples.en: There is a noticeable discrepancy in the witnesses' accounts.
examples.zh: 证人们的陈述存在明显不一致。

words.usage: 固定搭配 a discrepancy between A and B，指本应一致却出现不符；也可接 in；多用于数据、账目、证词等客观领域；形容词 discrepant。
collocations: a discrepancy between A and B A与B之间的差异
a discrepancy in the figures 数字出入
explain a discrepancy 解释差异
words.mnemonic: dis(不)+crep(响)+ancy → 声响不合 → 出入
